display: URGENT26 FlowSE baseline (official, 48k, without final peak normalisation)
notes: Conditional flow matching on an improved BSRNN backbone, Euler solver with 15 steps, EMA weights; per-file deterministic prior noise. Sampling-frequency independent; fed 48 kHz here. The official script's peak normalisation to 0.9 (a convention of the challenge's scale-invariant evaluation) is left out: the model's own output keeps the input's scale. Generative: see bench/METRICS.md, "How to read it". The prior noise is seeded per file name, so a cut of an item draws different noise from the item.
